topics.title: Blending sounds into words
topics.summary: Teach children to say each sound, then push the sounds together to read the word.
topics.fits: Kindergarten and 1st grade, once children know a few letter sounds
topics.query: teaching students to blend letter sounds to read words

topics.title: Hearing and playing with sounds
topics.summary: Short oral activities where children listen for, say and change the sounds in spoken words.
topics.query: phonemic awareness instruction hearing segmenting and manipulating sounds in spoken words

topics.title: Digraphs: sh, ch, th
topics.summary: Two letters that make one sound. Teach them explicitly after single letter sounds.
topics.query: explicit systematic phonics instruction letter-sound correspondences digraphs

topics.title: Decodable texts for practice
topics.summary: Short texts built from the sounds children have been taught, so they can practice decoding.
topics.query: decodable texts beginning readers practice taught letter-sound correspondences

topics.title: Building word knowledge
topics.summary: Teach new words with child-friendly meanings, examples and repeated chances to use them.
topics.query: vocabulary instruction teaching word meanings in the early grades

topics.title: Reading fluently
topics.summary: Repeated, supported reading of text at the right level helps children read smoothly.
topics.query: fluency instruction repeated reading with feedback
